title: Practice 12: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Сопрано получила оглушительные аплодисменты за ___ (своё выступление, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The soprano received thunderous applause for her performance.
exercises.why: **выступление → выступление** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **свой → свое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with выступление). Declines like мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он спрятал письмо под ___ (подсвечник, acc. sg.) и закрыл глаза.
exercises.why: **подсвечник → подсвечник** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
**волынка → волынку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**поезд → поезд** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **товарный → товарный** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with поезд). Declines like новый (A. anim. = G., inan. = N). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Дед легонько поталкивал лаптями под ___ (брюхо, acc. sg.) кобылы.
exercises.why: **брюхо → брюхо** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
